title: British Subject Arrested By Japanese Consular Police For Shop-Lifting

page_data.en:
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE 1416 4 2, 42）

Misc. 14/42.
"C"
Dixwell Road
February, 4th, 42.
1/1

British Subject Arrested by Japanese
Consular Police for Shop-lifting.

At 10 p.m. on the 3/2/42, F.S. Noda attached to
Dixwell Road Station, brought to station a British Subject,
named,
George Henry Gracles Cameron, 23, un-employed
residing at the Salvation Army Hostel. Chaufong
Road.
who had been handed into his custody by the Japanese Con-
sular Police. Scott Road, he having been handed into the
custody of the above authorities by a Japanese shop-master
named M. Kobayashi, 1236 N. Szechuen Road, from which place
the arrested man had stolen two Japanese English Diction-
aries value Yen six. approximately $24.00.

Interrogated at this station the above named person
admitted that at 6.10 p.m. on the date of arrest, he had
entered the above premises as a customer, and when thought
to be unobserved, had purloined the two books, which he
then placed in his overcoat pocket. This had been witness-
ed by the complainant, who had arrested him and then handed
him into the custody of the Japanese Consular Police.

Complainant was located at 9.30 a.m. on the 4/2/42,
and interviewed by Sub-Insp. Imura, stated that he desired
to proceed with the case.

（批：Major Yalo
and
C.S.L.
5. 2. 42
J.L.）

（批：$ 5/2）

D.S.I. Wilkinson.

（印：4/2/42 Gen. Det. 1/...
D. D. B. "C" Division.）
page_data.zh:
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 1416 4 2, 42）

杂项 14/42。
“C”分区
狄思威路
1942年2月4日。
1/1

英国侨民因商店行窃被日本领事馆警察逮捕。

1942年2月3日晚上10时，隶属狄思威路捕房的警员F.S. Noda将一名名为George Henry Gracles Cameron的英国侨民带至捕房。该人23岁，无业，居住在曹家渡路救世军收容所。此人系由日本领事馆警察移交其看管。此前，该人已被四川北路1236号的一名日本店主M. Kobayashi移交给上述当局看管，被捕者从该店窃取了两本日英词典，价值6日元，约合24.00美元。

经在本捕房讯问，上述人员承认，在逮捕当日下午6时10分，他以顾客身份进入上述处所，趁被认为无人注意之时，偷走了这两本书，并随即放入其大衣口袋内。此举被控告人目击，控告人随即将其逮捕，并移交给日本领事馆警察看管。

1942年2月4日上午9时30分找到控告人，副督察Imura对其进行了问话，控告人表示希望继续处理此案。

（批：Yalo少校
及
首席副督察
1942年2月5日
J.L.）

（批：$ 5/2）

副总监 Wilkinson。

（印：1942年2月4日 一般拘留 1/...
D. D. B. “C”分区。）
